advisory_findings.summary: The shared tracker-projection test only checks that ClaudeRuntime.runtime and PiRuntime.runtime are HostRuntime instances and that imm-canary-work.ts contains the 'await runtime.authorize(' text. It does not check that PiRuntime.submitVerification and PiRuntime.authorize actually delegate to this.runtime, so a Pi-side bypass of withTerminalTracker could go undetected.

evidence.trigger: If PiRuntime.authorize were changed to settle without calling this.runtime.authorize, the extension source would still contain 'await runtime.authorize(' and .runtime would still be a HostRuntime. The test would pass even though Pi skipped the shared post-settlement projection.
